name: anim_goo_flat
subject: a low wide puddle of thick pink and yellow marbled liquid paint on the floor
desc: The wide flat puddle heaves and churns: low lumps bulge up and sink back as if someone trapped just under the surface is struggling and kicking, a hand-like bulge pushes up and gets dragged back down, thick goo squelching, bubbles swelling and popping. It stays low and wide, never taller than a small bump. Loop.
